description.value: The Galley Lakeside Cafe sits on the Okanagan Lake waterfront at the Kelowna Yacht Club, a community fixture dating back to 1945. It serves handcrafted coffee drinks, salads, sandwiches, smoothies, beer, wine, and house-made gelato from a heated, dog-friendly patio with unobstructed lake views. A retail shop on-site carries local products and KYC merchandise, making it a natural stop for cyclists riding the downtown Kelowna waterfront.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 61m; lockers (secure) at 61m; lockers (secure) at 76m; lockers (secure) at 77m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Galley Lakeside Cafe is a publicly accessible café at the Kelowna Yacht Club on Water Street, open to walk-in customers; the front page explicitly invites the public to 'stop by.' The phone number (250-762-3310) and address (1370 Water Street, Kelowna, BC V1Y 1J1) are confirmed via the website's Contact page. 'Take Out & Online Ordering' appears in the site navigation, confirming takeout; no evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities was found in any fetched page.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible lakefront café in a prime downtown Kelowna waterfront location; website confirms it is open daily to walk-in customers.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Galley is distinct from the members-only Member Lounge dining room, which requires yacht club membership. The Galley itself is open to the general public.
